items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: I know when Punch and I, Punch and them started playing music

ctx.x: I'm going to ask about Joe Oliver. If you remember his band and hearing Joe when you were a kid?

Oh yeah, I heard his band. He used to play around at the, he played at the Carparetus Hall. He played at the Connemy Hall. Of course Buddy Petey and them used to play there too. He played with his buddy Petey and Kid Punch, Rainey.
Who was the best trumpet players in those days that you liked best? At that time?
